# llms.txt generation


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

``` python
from fastcore.test import test_eq
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
```

A package’s `skill.py` is the single source of truth for LLM
documentation: `doc(pkg.skill)` renders it in Python, and this module
renders the same file as `llms.txt` for web readers without importing
it. Skill docstrings use `###`+ headings so `# pkg` and `## Section`
stay reserved for `llms.txt`.

## Parsing `skill.py`

[`parse_skill`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/pyskills/llms.html#parse_skill)
reads a `skill.py` file via AST, splitting its docstring into a one-line
`summary` and `body`, and reading literal `__docs__` and `__base_url__`
assignments.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/pyskills/blob/main/pyskills/llms.py#L17"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### parse_skill

``` python
def parse_skill(
    path:str | pathlib.Path, # Path to a `skill.py` file
)->fastcore.basics.AttrDict: # `AttrDict(summary, body, docs, base_url)`
```

*Parse `skill.py`’s docstring and literal `__docs__` / `__base_url__`
via AST without importing it*

``` python
sk = parse_skill(Path('../pyskills/skill.py'))
assert sk.summary and sk.body and 'Docs' in sk.docs
sk.summary, sk.docs
```

## Formatting reference sections

[`_mod_line`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/pyskills/llms.html#_mod_line)
formats one module cross-reference using its AST docstring summary and
`mod_urls` entry. Pure-docstring modules without a web page, such as
`guidance.py` or `createskill.py`, emit a sibling `llms-<name>.txt`
companion file copied verbatim by Quarto.

``` python
comps = {}
ln = _mod_line('pyskills.createskill', Path('../pyskills').resolve(), 'pyskills', {}, comps)
assert '[pyskills.createskill](llms-createskill.txt):' in ln and list(comps) == ['llms-createskill.txt']
ln
```

[`_fmt_sect`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/pyskills/llms.html#_fmt_sect)
renders one `## Section` block, mixing module entries and
`(title, href, desc)` link tuples.

``` python
_fmt_sect('Docs', [('mod', 'pyskills.core'), ('link', 'Guide', 'guide.html.md', 'Intro')],
    Path('../pyskills').resolve(), 'pyskills', {'pyskills.core': 'core.html.md'}, {})
```

## Building `llms.txt`

[`pkg_llms`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/pyskills/llms.html#pkg_llms)
assembles the title, summary blockquote, normalized `Base URL:`, skill
body, reference sections, optional `## API` link (passed by `fastship`
`ship-docs`), and trailing marker.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/pyskills/blob/main/pyskills/llms.py#L54"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### pkg_llms

``` python
def pkg_llms(
    path:str | pathlib.Path, # Package directory containing `skill.py`
    base_url:str='', # Published docs base URL (normalized to end with `/`)
    mod_urls:dict=None, # Optional `{module_name: rel_url}` for modules with web doc pages
    api_url:str=None, # Optional relative URL for a top-level API page (e.g. `api.html.md`)
)->tuple[str, dict[str, str]]: # `(llms_txt, {companion_filename: content})`
```

*Build `llms.txt` and pure-docstring companion files from
`path/skill.py` without importing it*

``` python
txt,comps = pkg_llms('../pyskills', base_url='https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/pyskills',
    mod_urls={'pyskills.core': 'core.html.md', 'pyskills.llms': 'llms.html.md'})
assert 'Base URL: https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/pyskills/' in txt
assert '- [pyskills.core](core.html.md):' in txt and list(comps) == ['llms-createskill.txt']
txt[:500]
```

## Writing and updating `llms.txt`

[`update_llms_txt`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/pyskills/llms.html#update_llms_txt)
writes `llms.txt` and companion `llms-*.txt` files when absent or
generated, leaves hand-written files untouched, and removes stale
generated `llms-*.txt` files when `skill.py` or a companion disappears.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

<a
href="https://github.com/AnswerDotAI/pyskills/blob/main/pyskills/llms.py#L89"
target="_blank" style="float:right; font-size:smaller">source</a>

### update_llms_txt

``` python
def update_llms_txt(
    path:str | pathlib.Path, # Package directory containing `skill.py`
    fn:str | pathlib.Path=None, # Output `llms.txt` path (defaults to `<path>/../llms.txt`)
    base_url:str='', # Published docs base URL
    mod_urls:dict=None, # Optional `{module_name: rel_url}` map
    api_url:str=None, # Optional relative URL for a top-level API page
)->list[pathlib.Path]: # Paths written or removed (empty when unchanged)
```

*Write `llms.txt` and companion files when absent or generated; remove
stale generated files*

Create a small temporary package with `skill.py`, `guidance.py`,
`core.py`, a re-export barrel, a private module, and a stale generated
`llms-api.txt`.

``` python
_td = TemporaryDirectory()
d = Path(_td.name)
pkg = d/'demo'
pkg.mkdir()
(pkg/'skill.py').write_text('"""Demo summary.\n\n### Usage\n\n- fast\n"""\n__docs__ = {"Optional": [("Extra", "extra.html.md", "More")]}\n')
(pkg/'guidance.py').write_text('"""Domain rules.\n\nBe careful.\n"""\n')
(pkg/'core.py').write_text('"""Core helpers."""\ndef f(): pass\n')
(pkg/'barrel.py').write_text('from .core import *\n')
(pkg/'_priv.py').write_text('"""Hidden."""\ndef g(): pass\n')
(d/'llms-api.txt').write_text('old\n<!-- Generated by pyskills-llms; edit demo/skill.py, not this file -->\n')
```

Running
[`update_llms_txt`](https://AnswerDotAI.github.io/pyskills/llms.html#update_llms_txt)
writes `llms.txt` and `llms-guidance.txt`, skips `barrel.py` and
`_priv.py`, deletes the stale `llms-api.txt`, and returns the changed
paths. A second identical call returns an empty list.

``` python
fn = d/'llms.txt'
kw = dict(base_url='https://example.com/demo', mod_urls={'demo.core': 'core.html.md'}, api_url='api.html.md')
test_eq(set(update_llms_txt(pkg, fn, **kw)), {fn, d/'llms-guidance.txt', d/'llms-api.txt'})
test_eq(update_llms_txt(pkg, fn, **kw), [])
out = fn.read_text()
assert '- [demo.guidance](llms-guidance.txt): Domain rules.' in out and '- [API reference](api.html.md):' in out
assert '- [demo.core](core.html.md): Core helpers.' in out and 'barrel' not in out and '_priv' not in out
assert (d/'llms-guidance.txt').exists() and not (d/'llms-api.txt').exists()
out
```

Removing `skill.py` cleans up generated files, while a hand-written
`llms.txt` without a generator marker is never overwritten.

``` python
(pkg/'skill.py').unlink()
test_eq(set(update_llms_txt(pkg, fn)), {fn, d/'llms-guidance.txt'})
assert not fn.exists() and not (d/'llms-guidance.txt').exists()
fn.write_text('# Hand written\n')
test_eq(update_llms_txt(pkg, fn), [])
assert fn.read_text() == '# Hand written\n'
_td.cleanup()
```
